<div class="card-body">
'''Maneuver Check''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">飛行経路チェック</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">「デス・スター：トレンチ」に配備する。敵はトレンチを出る宇宙戦闘機の飛行経路チェックを行わねばならない。各宇宙戦闘機について、それぞれ運命数を引く。運命数＋回避値＜5なら、宇宙戦闘機はロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Maneuver-Check-SWCA-67742.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「ルーク、スピードを上げすぎたら、機体を立て直せなくなるぞ」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Maneuver Check.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on Death Star: Trench. Opponent must make a flight-path check for starfighters leaving the trench. For each starfighter, draw destiny. If destiny plus maneuver is less than 5, the starfighter is lost.

'''Lore:'''
Luke, if you raise the speed too much, you will not be able to pull the craft out.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 飛行経路チェック.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Maneuver Check]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
